Script the closed-beta error from the tool result, not from sign-in wording (loop 3 contract, §5.5). Without a valid code the tools are listed, and every call returns isError with structuredContent.beta.reason 'missing_code' or 'invalid_code' (tools.ts:975). I checked both: the de/en text is right and says 'do not retry the tools until they have reconnected'. SKILL.md:76 instead has the model say 'If your app asks you to sign in or says unauthorised, the link is missing your invite code'. That talks about a prompt she never saw, and it is wrong for a wrong code. It also never says to stop calling tools, and connect.md:26 repeats the old 401 wording. Fix: 'If a tool returns the closed-beta message (structuredContent.beta): relay it in her language in two or three sentences, missing or not valid as beta.reason says. Point her to beta.how_to_connect, make no more tool calls, and offer to carry on by hand.' Keep the sign-in line as the fallback for old hosts. It worked when a wrong-code session says the code is not valid, and makes no further tool calls.
